question: Which of the following companies announced the launch of India’s first virtual academy programme Esports Academy?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Asus**__.

__
 
• **Asus** announced the launch of **India’s first virtual academy program Esports Academy.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• The **Asus Republic of Gamers (ROG) **has announced the launch of the **Asus ROG Academy** in **India**.
 
• The competitive Esports training initiative will be** India's first virtual academy program **for upcoming **gamers** who are looking to be **professionals.**
